text_block_list.text:
How to repay Chairwoman Akikawa— Various 
ideas were put forth, centered around the 
students gathering in the field, but—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Well, at times like this, it's gotta be— 
"food", right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right! It's all thanks to the chairwoman 
that the academy's food is so rich and 
varied to begin with!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The best way to repay the favor of good 
food is with more good food! Nothing beats 
that!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
We're going all out for the Great Harvest 
Festival prep too, but for the thank-you 
dish, all the students are gonna join 
forces and make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's gather everyone's power into 
the best dish and inject some Buono Power 
into the Chairwoman~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If you have any good ideas, please feel 
free to share them...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice will think as hard as she can too...! 
Let's do our best, everyone...!

And so, we all joined forces to create the 
ultimate dish for Chairwoman Akikawa.

“—I have a bit of free time today. Maybe I 
should go help out the students working 
hard on crafting the menu.”

Or perhaps I could go see Chairwoman 
Akikawa and casually ask about her 
favorites. Now then, what should I do—

I decided to go help Katsuragi Ace. Now 
then, where could she be—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Oh! Hey there, Trainer! I was just coming 
by to check on the vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Cooking is great and all, but 
growing vegetables is definitely where I 
can contribute the most!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, could you check on the 
new chili pepper bunch over there? It's 
just about time to set up their stakes.

Field vegetables are the foundation of 
recipe creation. Sweating brow-to-brow 
alongside Katsuragi Ace, we devoted 
ourselves to tending to the crops――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Sorry, Trainer-san! For making you 
stay with me until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Look at that. Thanks to you, don't the 
veggies look like they've perked right up?
choice_data_list:
I'm sure they'll grow into delicious 
fruit.
I'm sure they'll grow to be delicious.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The best dishes can't start without 
the best vegetables. ...I'm countin' on 
ya, veggies!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Man, I don't know. I feel like I'm 
turning more and more into my old man back 
home.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Talking to vegetables was originally my 
dad's habit anyway—and what I told Rice 
and the others at the training camp was 
really just second-hand advice.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"The more care you give them daily, the 
better the vegetables will respond."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"He'd say, 'We should always be grateful 
for it and say grace before eating.' Back 
then, I just thought, 'Yeah, yeah, I get 
it.'"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Facing these vegetables every single 
day, I feel like I finally understand the 
true meaning behind it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
They grow so strong and full of life. And 
because of that, eating them keeps us 
energized too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Food really does exist thanks to 'giving 
thanks,' doesn't it..."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“—Thanks, you guys. Make sure you bear 
fruit in the greatest way possible.”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll be taking it in the finest form 
possible, too.

It was a day spent with Katsuragi Ace 
gaining a newfound appreciation for the 
profound depths of "food."

I decided to go help out Special Week. Now 
then, where could she be—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was just about to head into town for a 
food tour to get some ideas for the menu.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...It's research, okay? Really. Besides, 
it's fine. Today's my cheat day!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's start with this shop! I 
just love the food here! I'm sure it'll 
give us some hints for the menu—

text_block_list.name: Megamori Restaurant Customer
text_block_list.text:
!? T-This is bad! "Bottomless Pit Spe" is 
here!

text_block_list.name: Megamori Restaurant Manager
text_block_list.text:
Cook more rice! It's gonna be gone in a 
flash!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh!? W-Wait, it's a misunderstanding~! 
Today I just wanted to learn the secret 
behind how delicious this place is—

...Despite a few mishaps, the 
'investigation' progressed—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whew, for a moment there I wondered what 
was going to happen, but thanks to all the 
great advice from the shopkeepers, it 
turned out to be a really meaningful 
survey!
choice_data_list:
Looks like this could be good inspiration 
for seasoning.

Looks like this could be good inspiration 
for seasoning.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's true, but... somehow, I feel like I 
was able to learn something truly 
important once again.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I want to bring joy to the people who eat 
my cooking." That heartfelt wish is poured 
into every single dish.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, the Chairwoman 
back then had those same feelings toward 
us students too."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To me, "food" is definitely all 
about—satisfaction!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"A meal that fills your heart as much as 
your stomach! I want to return the favor 
to the Chairwoman!"

Through the investigation, Special Week 
seems to have clearly identified the 
feelings she wants to convey above all 
else.

I decided to go help Nishino Flower. Now 
then, I wonder where she could be—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Ah! Hello, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... do I smell like curry, by any 
chance...? I was working on making the 
menu until just now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I've studied so much up until now, but... 
when I think about bringing 'the ultimate 
dish' together on a single plate... I just 
can't seem to find the answer."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The best healthy food... On top of that, 
does it mean a dish that's delicious above 
all else...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! There you are, Flower-chan! You got a 
package delivered!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...! It's from Mom...! Right, I did ask 
her for advice about the menu over the 
phone the other day...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"—I'm sending the recipe notes that Mom 
made when Flower-chan was little."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I don't think it turned out very well, 
but I hope it helps you even a little bit. 
Do your best. From Mom"...

A collection of recipes written by Nishino 
Flower's mother. They lacked structure, 
and even at a glance, you could sense a 
clumsiness in the notes, but—

What caught my eye, however—were notes 
detailing her daughter's favorite snacks 
and nourishing meals to prepare when she 
fell ill.

From that section showing traces of trial 
and error and being rewritten time and 
time again, a mother's unmistakable love 
could be felt.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...... It seems I was worrying over 
something silly.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll just put all my heart into cooking 
the food that would make the Chairwoman 
happiest. ...Just like my mother used to 
do for me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Food is devotion. ...Thank you for 
teaching me that, Mom."

It seemed Nishino Flower had found a 
precious spark of inspiration from her 
mother's gift.

I decided to go help Hishi Akebono. Now, 
where could she be—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ooh, Trainer! Hello~☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Right now~, I was making chanko nabe to 
treat everyone running alongside me~.

Looking over, there was a portable stove, 
a huge pot, and a mountain of ingredients 
nearby—so I decided to help out by 
chopping the ingredients.
choice_data_list:
So you're planning to make the special 
menu hot pot as well?

Are you really planning to make hot pot 
for the special menu too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'm thinking about that too, but~... 
Lately, I've been feeling like I want to 
think more and more about chankonabe.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know, the Chairwoman... is definitely 
trying to become chanko nabe herself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"The Chairwoman's wish is for all of us to 
keep running happily and healthily, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"The Chairwoman is... like a pot of chanko 
nabe that always, alwaaays brings out our 
absolute best!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm sure my dream and the Chairwoman's 
dream are the exact same!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I want to make food that'll keep the 
Chairwoman going at full power forever, 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
To me, "food" is— always, no matter what 
kind of dish it is, "chanko nabe"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So, I want to start thinking up the menu 
beginning with standard chanko nabe~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume after Training Match
text_block_list.text:
Whew, I'm beat...! ...Hm? Ooh, that smells 
good...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Great work today, everyone~☆ Come on, eat 
up, eat up~!

"Food means chanko nabe"... Once again, I 
felt Hishi Akebono's unshakable 
conviction, steady as a yokozuna's shiko 
stomp.

I decided to go help Rice Shower. Now, 
where could she be—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah! Ehehe, hello.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You see, the cafeteria staff let me use 
the kitchen to make some prototypes. 
Curry, ramen, and a few other things.
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can help with?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure? In that case, um... could 
you give it a taste test...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! Thank you! To think you'd eat the 
whole thing...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... You know, lately Rice has been 
feeling really happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even through cooking... even Rice can make 
everyone feel happy, huh...
choice_data_list:
You've always worked hard on your diet, 
after all.

You've always worked hard on your diet, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Rice understands what Madam Chairwoman 
was saying very well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...I want all of us to keep running, full 
of energy, forever."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... you want them to stay 
happy forever?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice wants to... return those feelings 
with cooking.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Food that makes you feel truly happy from 
the bottom of your heart once you eat it. 
I want to serve that kind of "meal"—to the 
Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Y-You say that, but I don't really 
have the confidence... Ehehe."
choice_data_list: I'm sure you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You think so...? ...Yeah, you're right. 
Even if Rice can't do it alone...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I've got everyone right here to cook with 
me!

The light in Rice Shower's eyes— through 
the time spent working with food, she 
seemed to have gained true strength.

I decided to go do some research around 
Chairwoman Akikawa. That said, it would be 
bad if she realized the surprise. I have 
to tread carefully—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mmh? My favorite food, you ask?
choice_data_list:
Something you want to eat, or even a taste 
of nostalgia...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, sushi is my favorite, but... I just 
had some the other day. Usually it's 
business dinners or simple, quick meals, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, that reminds me! Speaking of 
memorable tastes, I recall going to a 
family restaurant with Tazuna once upon a 
time.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The moment I saw the menu, I instantly 
knew and ordered the kids' meal... Man, 
I'll never forget it!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm. I certainly enjoyed the taste, but— 
think about it.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A kids' meal set and this academy— Don't 
you think they're remarkably similar?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Take hamburger steak, Napolitan, fried 
shrimp, pilaf—every single dish lined up 
is a headliner!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Even so, they sat together on a single 
plate, bringing out the best in each 
other's brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It overlaps directly with the sight of so 
many students clashing on their respective 
stages— or so I believe!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, every time I look at a kid's 
meal, my resolve is renewed.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Like the sparkle of countless stars, we 
must ensure the academy remains a place 
that offers opportunities to shine for 
many students.

I thought it was just her favorite food, 
but for there to be a reason like that... 
Once again, I felt a deep sense of 
reverence for Chairwoman Akikawa's 
greatness.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, that flag stuck into the pilaf is 
exquisite! It has a truly exhilarating 
charm to it!
...In the end, maybe I just love it.
